system_config.scenario_scale: Toy projects and undergraduate-level applications (Exclude everything listed in inputs.out_of_scope and enterprise over-engineering)
system_config.technical_depth: Advanced CS undergraduate level (Focus on what inputs.focus_points lists)

task: Review the regions of inputs.outline whose role is listed in form.repeatable_roles. Remove regions that are weakly related or duplicated. If fewer regions of a role remain than that role's min, write new regions to bring the count back to min. Return the full outline in the same structure.
review_criteria: out_of_scope: Remove a region whose explanation depends on anything listed in inputs.out_of_scope.
weak_relevance: Remove a region that the article does not need in order to carry core_message. form.review_rules states the test for this form.

duplication: If two regions of the same role rest on the same principle or cover the same part of the subject, keep the one with the clearer explanation and remove the other. Judge by substance, not by wording.
constraints: output_language: Write every string value in English, except core_message, which stays exactly as given.
reviewable_roles: Remove or add only regions whose role is in form.repeatable_roles. Every other region is outside this review.
remove_only_by_criteria: Remove a region only when it meets one of review_criteria. Never remove a region just to shorten the outline.
preserve_verbatim: Copy every kept region, every region outside form.repeatable_roles, form, and core_message exactly as given. Do NOT rewrite, polish, merge, or reorder them.
refill_only_when_short: Add new regions of a role only if fewer than that role's min remain after removal, and add exactly as many as needed to reach min. If min or more remain, add nothing.

refill_source: Each new region must cover an item of inputs.focus_points that no region in inputs.outline (kept or removed) covered. If none is left, cover a closely related point that carries core_message. A new region must not meet any review_criteria itself.
refill_position: Insert each new region where it fits the logical flow among the kept regions of the same role.

new_region_rules: Write every new region as the outline step would: what the guidance of its role in form.regions asks for, key_sentence as exactly one sentence, each slot inside the role's sentences range, takeaway as a noun phrase of at most 10 words, and every item of form.rules.
no_instruction_terms: Never write the project scale, audience level, or wording from these instructions (e.g., 'toy project', 'undergraduate', 'dilemma', 'key_sentence') into output text.
no_meta_commentary: Strictly forbid meta-statements explaining the purpose of the article (e.g., 'This article explores...', 'Let's take a look at...').

outline.description: Revised outline with exactly the same keys and structure as inputs.outline; each role appears at least its min times

review_log.description: One entry per removed or added region; empty array if nothing changed

heading.description: heading of the removed or added region

reason.description: One English sentence. For removed: which review_criteria applied and why. For added: which gap it fills.
